meta.name: seo-strategy
meta.description: Audits and improves organic search performance — technical health, site architecture, internal linking, structured data, and the content decisions that determine what can rank. Use this to run an SEO audit, diagnose why pages are not ranking or were deindexed, plan a site's URL and navigation structure, add structured data, or prioritize which SEO fixes are worth doing.

copy.tagline: 诊断网站搜索排名问题并制定优化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有网站但自然搜索流量上不去
copy.tagline_en: Audit your site's organic search and plan fixes to boost rankings.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a website but organic search traffic is flat.

howto.what: 让 Claude 按顺序审计网站的 SEO：先查能否被抓取和收录，再核对页面是否匹配搜索意图、网站有无足够权威。它会给出按严重程度分级的发现、证据、修复清单、预期影响和暂不修复项。
howto.when: 当你说“做SEO审计”“诊断页面上不了榜”等，或要求规划站点的URL/导航结构时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个网站的SEO，按严重程度排序问题。
say.note: 会先检查爬取和收录，再给修复清单。

say.text: 我的产品页没被收录，查查为什么。
给这个电商站规划URL和内部链接结构。
say.note: 按点击可达性和内容分组来设计。

howto.what_en: Makes Claude audit a site's SEO in order: check crawlability and indexation, then check search-intent match and authority. Outputs findings by severity with evidence, a sequenced fix list, expected impact and timing, and what is deliberately left unfixed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for an SEO audit, ask why pages are not ranking or were deindexed, or request URL/navigation planning.

say_en.text: Audit my website's SEO and rank the issues by severity.
say_en.note: It starts with crawl and index checks, then gives a fix list.

say_en.text: Why are my product pages not indexed?
say_en.note: Checks index status, canonicals, and duplicates.

say_en.text: Plan the URL and internal linking structure for this e-commerce site.
say_en.note: Designs around click depth and content grouping.
